name: Fishguard Foodbank
description: Nearest foodbank at Fishguard. Part of The Trussell Trust network. Open Wed 10am-1pm for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Pembrokeshire County Council Allotments
short_description: Pembrokeshire Council allotment sites in Crymych area
description: Small plots available in the Crymych/Banwen area. From £18/year. Contact for current availability and waiting lists.

name: Crymych Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Crymych Memorial Hall
description: Volunteer-run garden behind the memorial hall. Grows hardy vegetables suited to the Preseli Hills climate. Surplus shared with elderly residents.
